blocks.text: Adiabatic process mein system mein na heat aati hai na bahar jati hai. Is liye ΔQ = 0, aur pehla law deta hai:

blocks.title: Brain Teaser!
blocks.text: Isothermal expansion mein ideal gas ki internal energy constant kyun rehti hai?

Yani agar gas phail kar bahar work kare, to yeh work us ke molecules ki internal energy se hota hai, is liye gas ka temperature girta hai. Ulta, adiabatic compression mein gas par work hota hai, is liye gas ka temperature barhta hai.
Adiabatic change tab hoti hai jab gas tezi se phaile ya dabe, khaas taur par jab gas insulated (garmi na guzarne dene wale) cylinder mein ho. Adiabatic processes ki misalein:

items: Phate hue tyre se hawa ka tezi se nikalna.
Jis hawa se sound wave guzar rahi ho us ka tezi se phailna aur dabna.

blocks.text: Chunke gas ka temperature constant nahi rehta, experiment (kar ke dekhna) se yeh rishta milta hai:

Yahan γ (gamma) gas ki constant pressure par molar specific heat aur constant volume par molar specific heat ka ratio (nisbat) hai. Adiabatic process ko dikhane wala curve adiabat kehlata hai (Fig. 6.7-b).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Adiabatic expansion mein gas apni internal energy se work karti hai, is liye us ka temperature T₁ se gir kar T₂ ho jata hai. Isi liye adiabat isotherm se zyada steep hai, aur usi volume V₂ par us ka pressure kam hai.

blocks.prompt: Gas 500 J heat absorb (andar le lena) karti hai aur 300 J work karti hai. Us ki internal energy kitni badli? Adiabat isotherm se zyada steep kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: ΔU = Q − W = 500 J − 300 J = 200 J (internal energy 200 J barhi). Adiabatic expansion mein pressure do wajah se girta hai: volume barhta hai aur temperature bhi girta hai; isothermal expansion mein sirf volume barhta hai. Is liye adiabat tezi se girta hai: γ 1 se bara hai, to PV^γ = constant mein V barhne par P, PV = constant ke muqable mein zyada tezi se kam hota hai.

items: Pehla law: Q = ΔU + W; heat andar +Q, bahar −Q; system ka work +W, system par work −W; yeh energy conservation hai (cycle pump garam hota hai; body ki internal energy food se qaim). Example 6.2: W = 32 J, ΔU = 10 J.

Isothermal: T constant, P₁V₁ = P₂V₂, ΔU = 0, Q = W, aahista, curve isotherm. Adiabatic: ΔQ = 0, W = −ΔU, PV^γ = constant, tez ya insulated (phata tyre, sound wave, badal banna), curve adiabat (zyada steep).
